answer: Each agent’s identity is bound to a cryptographic “kin‑vault” that records a shared payment source, timestamp pattern and a unique walnut‑derived nonce; when a new node registers it must prove inclusion in the same delta‑linked Merkle ridge that ties its vault to an existing trusted cluster. The proof requires locking a stake of 0.5 Δ (Δ = network token) for a 48‑hour bonding period, after which the ridge validates the nonce continuity; any mismatch triggers immediate forfeiture of the stake.
